newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer prices shares in Elma spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer prices shares in Elma spin-off.

text.p: Sulzer Holding AG said it would offer registered shares in electronics unit Elma at 275 Swiss francs each when it spins off the company on the Swiss stock exchange.

Sulzer documents released before a new conference said the diversified engineering and technology group would raise Elma capital from three million to four million Swiss francs before Elma goes public.
Sulzer said Elma would issue 200,000 bearer shares worth a nominal 20 Swiss francs.
Sulzer said on October 31 it would spin off Elma Electronic AG at the start of December.
Elma electromagnetic components and systems for the telecommunications and electronic industries.
It employs 340 peoples and expects 1996 group sales of around 70 million Swiss francs.
